prompt: Which two pictures would best show whether a pouch’s seam was closed by the repair?
promptZh: 哪兩張照片最能看出修補是否讓小袋接縫合起來？

options.text: Two pictures at the workbench lamp with the pouch lying flat
options.zh: 兩次都在工作台燈下，把小袋平放拍照
options.whyZh: 光線一致，但小袋平放可能把開口壓住，前後照片無法可靠顯示修補是否有效。

options.text: Two pictures by the window, each with a card inside the pouch
options.zh: 兩次都在窗邊拍，小袋裡都放一張卡片
options.whyZh: 卡片能讓開口看得見，但活動到尾聲窗邊會進入陰影，前後光線不同。

options.text: One picture with a card inside, then one without it, both at the workbench
options.zh: 兩張都在工作台拍；第一張放卡片，第二張不放
options.whyZh: 燈光沒變，但拿掉卡片後小袋鬆扁，可能讓還在的開口看起來像補好了。

options.text: Two pictures at the workbench lamp, each with a card inside the pouch
options.zh: 兩次都在工作台燈下拍，小袋裡都放一張卡片
options.whyZh: 卡片讓小袋呈現使用時的形狀，不會因放平而遮掉開口；工作台照明前後也保持一致。

evidence:
a loose seam looked closed because the pouch lay flat.
A card slipped inside gave it the shape it has in use, and we could see the gap.
The window seat gets shade by the end of the session; the lamp on the workbench stays the same.
explanationZh: 卡片讓小袋呈現使用時的形狀，不會因放平而遮掉開口；工作台照明前後也保持一致。

vocabulary.note: seam 是布片縫合的接縫；接縫鬆開時，袋子平放可能看不出開口。
